description.value:
You are a generalist of chakra-driven techniques. You become trained in two additional skills of your choice and gain access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-actions.Item.ClAcFiveElement0]{Five Elemental Seal} class action, which lets you cycle between your trained nature affinities mid-encounter.

TODO: when the spells pack ships elemental jutsu (M4), this feature will gate access to all five elements at-will via a Heightened mechanic.
